title: Add AsyncPCK support (`ResourceLoader.load_threaded_*` version)

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body: Supersedes #114690 ### Changes from the previous PR This PR is essentially #114690 rebased to `master`, but with a few changes following the TLC comments. - It removes the `AsyncPckInstaller` node which was an developer utility to speed up integration of Async in their project. - It removes the `OS::async_pck_*` methods from the public API. - It integrates async support with the `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_*` API. The idea behind putting the AsyncPCK logic behind `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_*` was twofold: - to prevent adding new APIs. - to simplify the async loading for users. ### Important caveats when using `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_*` instead of a dedicated AsyncPCK API In my opinion, I think that the fact that `load()` cannot stop the engine on the Web[^1] until the missing files are downloaded and installed really complicates everything. - The docs for `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_*` have now multiple caveats attached to them. (see screenshots below) - On single-threaded Web exports, as the download and the load phases are merged, when big assets are downloaded, the engine will heavily stutter to load them. There's currently no way to download files independently (during playing the level) from loading (during a loading or black screen). - Essentially forces the user to load every asset with the `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_*` API, effectively banning the simpler `load()` method. - There's currently no way to track how many bytes have been downloaded, and the bytes total of each files. The information has been constrained to the `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status()` progress value. (IMHO, the fact that Godot doesn't display that data (or offer devs to choose to) on the first load is a bug, not a feature.) [^1]: It's not possible without building the WASM file with [Emscripten](https://emscripten.org/)'s [Asyncify](https://emscripten.org/docs/porting/asyncify.html) API (which really bumps up the size of the WASM output, which kinda defeats the purpose of the PR to load games faster on Web). #### Docs for `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_*` Yellow boxes are for emphasis. | `ResourceLoader` method | Screenshot | | :---: | :---: | | `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get()` | | | `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status()` | | | `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request()` | |
